results.title: Translating Lipoprotein Genetics Into New Therapies.
results.abstract: Human genetics has become the primary engine for identifying lipid-lowering drug targets and predicting therapeutic success or failure. Monogenic family studies and population-based sequencing identify individuals with lifelong loss-of-function variants in lipoprotein-regulatory genes who are simultaneously healthier and inadvertent proof-of-concept trial participants-the human knockout paradigm.
